name: Nadab
bio: Nadab was Jeroboam's son, who succeeded him as king of Israel after Jeroboam's twenty-two-year reign ended (1 Kings 14:20), reigning two years and doing evil in the LORD's eyes just as his father had (1 Kings 15:25-26). While Nadab and all Israel were besieging the Philistine town of Gibbethon, his official Baasha conspired against him, struck him down, and seized the throne, then wiped out Jeroboam's entire family — fulfilling the LORD's judgment against Jeroboam's house spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite (1 Kings 15:27-29).
